Repair User Guide — Factory

Type 3: Not Under Warranty (With Serial No) — Tested OK

Source: Odoo Tour Recorder export — Tour/3B. Repair User Guide - Factory [ Not Under Warranty ( With Serial No ) - Tested Ok ].json

Scenario: The product is out of warranty but has a serial number. It is checked at the factory and found Tested OK, returned to the sales centre and dispatched back to the customer.
Every screenshot below is a real capture from a single, clean, passing automated run — taken before each step's action, with the element to use framed in red.

1. Overview

This manual explains how to register and complete a factory repair for a customer's product whose warranty has expired and which has an existing serial number, when the technician finds the item Tested OK — nothing needs repairing. It runs from the Helpdesk ticket, through the factory and the sales centre, to dispatch back to the customer.

Ticket stages covered

New Sent to Factory Received at Factory Repair Completed Sent to Sales Centre Received at Sales Centre Handed Over to Customer

Before you start

  • You have access to the Helpdesk, Field Service and Inventory apps.
  • The active company (top bar) is Jinasena Agricultural Machinery (Pvt) Ltd.
  • The customer and the finished product (with its serial number, already sold through a sales order) already exist in Odoo.
  • The item has been physically brought to the branch by the customer.

DescriptionOpens the Helpdesk Overview dashboard, showing every support team you have access to.

QA notes
  • Steps 1-17 follow the Not Under Warranty (With Serial No) - Full Flow (3A) guide: no Product selection and no Create Serial No step; the item is identified by an existing Serial Number, which fills in the Product. No warranty card is needed because the warranty has expired. From the task onward the flow follows the Tested OK pattern: Tested OK replaces diagnosis / image / parts / quotation / deposit / deliveries / balance payment.
  • The Serial Number field only offers serials already sold to a customer. The tour typed its own serial; as required by the test-data rules the automated run picks a serial of [JMC6] whose on-hand quantity is zero (this run used 0630_010), skipping serials that still hold stock in a Repair location, which would make the receipt and the Dispatch fail. The Product field is filled from the serial.
  • The tour selects the Return Receipt Location "Jinasena Ampara Branch"; the automated run selects its stock location BR-AM/Stock. The tour also has an Open Task click after Create & View Task; on this instance the task is already open at that point, so there is no separate step for it. The tooltip text of the tour's Type step is copied from the Without Serial No type; the option actually selected is Repair - Not Under Warranty (With Serial No).
  • The Return button (fix_repair_action_direct_return) raises "You may only return Done pickings" server-side but still creates the Returned Picking first. The automated run clicks the real button, falls back to the same call via /web/dataset/call_kw if no picking appears, and validates the receipt through RPC (the receipt's Validate button is hidden by the Studio views). The receipt opens as a full page, so the Back screenshot (step 13) shows the Done receipt without a framed button.
  • Send to Sales Centre and Dispatch become visible only after a full page reload once the previous action completes. A hash-only navigation does not refresh the record, so the automated flow uses page.reload() in a polling loop.
  • Each screenshot is captured immediately before the step's action with the target element framed in red (a temporary CSS outline applied to the live element only for the capture); result screenshots (serial entered, final ticket) have no box. Screenshots come from one clean, fully-passing automated run (admin role): ticket REPAIR/2026/01651.
  • The "Add Data" toast notifications on the Tested OK screenshot (diagnosis/image not set) are expected for this shortcut path; they do not block the flow.
  • Every screenshot shows a red "Database neutralized for testing: no emails sent, etc." banner at the top. This is expected on the test database and is not part of the normal production screen.
